units: All tons are US short tons (2,000 lb). Green tons are fresh-cut wood including its water; dry tons exclude it.

green_to_pellet_ratio.label: Green Tons Required
green_to_pellet_ratio.note: PFPI estimate, needs a citation. Depends on feedstock moisture and process losses (bark, fines, dryer losses); mills vary.

moisture.label: Moisture content of fresh-cut wood intake
moisture.note: Industry standard for green wood; fresh-cut pine is about half water by weight.
moisture.source: Zerbe & Bergman (2004), USDA Forest Products Laboratory

pellet_moisture.label: Finished pellet moisture
pellet_moisture.note: Informational; not used in the wood-demand calculation.

process_energy_share.label: Share of intake burned for kiln/dryer heat
process_energy_share.note: PFPI estimate, needs a citation. Many mills burn bark and fines (already excluded from the wood-intake figure here) rather than merchantable wood; this fraction drives the mill's own stack CO2, separate from the carbon in the pellets themselves.

tons_per_load.range_source: Range across 24 Southern mills, Hamsley et al. (2007)
tons_per_load.label: Truck load size
tons_per_load.note: Average net loads at 24 Southern mills were 24-29 tons, about 26.4 overall (2,105,441 tons from 79,760 trucks).
tons_per_load.source: Hamsley et al. (2007), Southern Journal of Applied Forestry 31(1): 12-16

haul_days_yr.label: Delivery days
haul_days_yr.note: Weekdays only. Use 365 if deliveries run every day.

share_by_truck.label: Share of wood delivered by truck
share_by_truck.note: The rest arrives by barge or rail. Lowers trucks, truck-miles and hauling diesel; barge and rail fuel aren't counted.

truck_length_ft.label: Length of a loaded log truck (tractor plus trailer)

truck_mpg.label: Combination-truck fuel economy
truck_mpg.note: National average for combination trucks; loaded log trucks on rural roads likely do worse, so diesel figures are conservative.

diesel_co2_lb.label: Diesel CO2 emission factor
diesel_co2_lb.source: U.S. EIA, Carbon Dioxide Emissions Coefficients

diesel_pm_g_per_mi.label: Heavy diesel particulate matter (exhaust, brake and tire)
diesel_pm_g_per_mi.note: 2021 rate, the most recent non-projected year.

clearcut_green_tons_per_acre.label: Average Southern pine clearcut (logs)
clearcut_green_tons_per_acre.note: Plantation 99, natural 86, thinning 32 green tons per acre.

green_tons.label: Green tons of wood a year
green_tons.note: Calculated from the mill above; type a number to use a different amount.

species.label: Type of wood
species.note: Which existing harvest the mill is compared with, and where its wood is assumed to come from. Hardwood is all non-pine species.

distance_bands.label: Distance bands
distance_bands.note: Circles around the site used to total the forest (up to 8 bands, 1–300 miles).

clearcut_share.label: Wood from clearcuts
clearcut_share.note: The rest comes from thinnings. Changing one changes the other.

thinning_share.label: Wood from thinnings
thinning_share.note: Thinnings yield far less wood per acre, so more acres are cut.
